launch.sequentialDesc: Executes models and experiments one by one in queue. Ideal to avoid overloading local GPUs (Ollama) or exceeding API rate limits.
launch.parallelDesc: Launches execution immediately in parallel. Faster benchmarking if you have multiple GPUs or cloud APIs.

launch.persistenceDesc: The evaluator stores every result immediately into PostgreSQL after processing each sample. You can pause at any time and resume exactly at the next sample without losing data or API quota.
launch.errorModelRequired: You must select at least one model to evaluate.
launch.errorTemplateRequired: The prompt template cannot be empty.

mae.label: MAE
mae.desc: Mean Absolute Error against Ground Truth

tolerance.label: Tolerance
tolerance.desc: Percentage of inferences within acceptable mathematical error margin

json_validity.label: JSON Validity
json_validity.desc: Rate of structurally valid JSON outputs

verbatim.label: Verbatim Faithfulness
verbatim.desc: Rate of exact verbatim citations without hallucination

disjointness.label: Disjointness
disjointness.desc: Strict separation between opposing sentiment citations

verbatim_faithfulness.name: Verbatim Anti-Hallucination Faithfulness
verbatim_faithfulness.shortDesc: Verifies that every verbatim quote cited by the LLM exists word-for-word in the original customer review.

internal_consistency_llm.name: Citation Disjointness (Pos ∩ Neg = ∅)
internal_consistency_llm.shortDesc: Evaluates internal coherence by verifying the same annotator does not cite the same phrase as evidence of opposite sentiments.

rule_consistency.name: Logical Derivation Consistency
rule_consistency.shortDesc: Verifies that the overall polarity assigned by the model matches the arithmetic balance of its extracted citations.

inter_rater_agreement.name: Inter-Rater Agreement: Cohen's Kappa (κ)
inter_rater_agreement.shortDesc: Measures categorical concordance between two annotators (LLM vs Human or LLM vs LLM), adjusting for chance agreement.

krippendorff_alpha.name: Krippendorff's Alpha (α)
krippendorff_alpha.shortDesc: Rigorous methodological standard for content analysis. Penalises disagreement independently of sample size.

polarity_count_agreement_icc.name: Count Agreement: ICC(2,1)
polarity_count_agreement_icc.shortDesc: Two-way Intraclass Correlation Coefficient with absolute agreement on extracted citation count per review.

rating_congruence.name: External Convergent Validity (Spearman rs)
rating_congruence.shortDesc: Models ordinal association between a computed model signal or spec (e.g. NSS) and an external dataset criterion variable.

json_validity.name: Strict JSON Schema Compliance
json_validity.shortDesc: Percentage of inferences with syntactically valid JSON structure and presence of all mandatory fields.

numeric_accuracy.name: MAE, RMSE & Arithmetic Tolerance
numeric_accuracy.shortDesc: For mathematical tasks: Mean Absolute Error, Root Mean Squared Error, and percentage of predictions within tolerance.

prevalence_positive_ratio.name: Positive Sentiment Ratio (Prevalence)
prevalence_positive_ratio.shortDesc: Calculates percentage of positive evaluations over total active mentions: SUM(Positive) / SUM(Active) * 100.

net_sentiment_score.name: Net Sentiment Score (NSS)
net_sentiment_score.shortDesc: Standardised net sentiment balance: (Positive - Negative) / (Positive + Negative).
